Subject: Post-call: FlowCommerce pilot - stakeholder map & security deliverables

Hi Tasha / Eli — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth from the call.

Attendees (FlowCommerce): Tasha Lin (VP Product), Eli Morales (CFO), "Security Team" TBD
Attendees (Redwood): Priya N., Ben Carter (Sales Eng), Aditya Rao (Security & Compliance)

Key outcomes:
- Fit / intent: FlowCommerce is interested in a 6-week pilot (limited scope: order routing & merchant messaging) to validate latency and cost improvements.
- Economic buyer: Eli Morales (CFO) — he asked for unit-cost projections and total cost-of-ownership comparison vs current managed endpoints.
- Security bar: SOC 2 Type II required. FlowCommerce will also want a summary of our pen-test posture and access to audit-log retention policies.
- Procurement: procurement@flowcommerce.com is the contact for contractual steps; they requested a draft SOW + commercial term sheet for their review.

Immediate asks / owners:
1) Priya (me): deliver short playbook email to the stakeholders with ask list and timeline (this message).
2) Aditya: produce SOC 2 summary + list of specific artifacts (AICPA report pointers, auditor contact, sampling window) by EOD Thursday.
3) Ben: coordinate commercial terms and produce draft SOW + simple pricing model (monthly commit and pilot pricing) by next Wednesday.
4) Tasha / Eli: confirm procurement contact and internal timeline for approvals.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (overview), soc2-audit-bridge-note.txt (mapping table), pen-test-request-form.pdf (form for penetration testing scope).

Proposed timeline:
- May 12: Redwood sends SOC2 summary and pen-test scoping form (Aditya)
- May 14: Ben shares draft SOW + pricing
- May 18–20: security sync call (if requested) between Aditya + FlowCommerce security

Please reply inline to confirm or correct any details. If the procurement contact is different, paste the email and I'll loop them in.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
redwood.com

Thanks Priya — this is great and captures everything. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed economic buyer: Eli Morales (CFO) — he’ll be the primary sign-off for spend, but procurement will own contract language.
- Procurement contact: procurement@flowcommerce.com (copying here as requested). They usually require a 2–3 week review window for standard SOWs.
- Security: our InfoSec lead, Maya Singh, will triage SOC2 artifacts. She prefers a short inventory (not full reports) first — AICPA letter, auditor contact, and any compensating controls notes.

We appreciate the timeline. Can you also include a short cost sensitivity analysis in the pricing packet (i.e., what changes at 2x/5x token volume)? Eli will want to see that.

We’ll expect the SOC2 summary and the pen-test scoping form; Maya will reach out to Aditya directly if she needs anything else.

Tasha
